verdict.rationale: The guidance pages on www.inpi.fr (trademark, patent, design and e-Soleau filing guides, directives, decisions) appear in the pack with extracted titles and content, which implies the public reading surface was retrievable. However, no probe directly confirms keyless, identified-UA access to www.inpi.fr without a bot wall or JS shell. The only probe shows data.inpi.fr returning HTTP 403 to a keyless GET, so at least one public INPI surface blocks keyless agents. That portal is the open-data surface, not the guidance pages, so it lowers confidence without contradicting this story. Missing for 10: a direct probe of www.inpi.fr guidance pages showing HTTP 200 with server-rendered content for an identified agent UA, confirmation of no CAPTCHA or bot challenge, and consistent keyless access across INPI's public surfaces.
